01 / SHORT ASSIGNMENTS

One problem.
One useful outcome.

I work best on a defined issue with an expected result. These are good starting points for a first collaboration.

01 / APIFOCUSED SCOPE

Fix a Spring Boot API

An endpoint fails, access rules are wrong, or a workflow needs one additional operation. I trace the cause and implement a targeted change.

What you receive

A code change, a short explanation of the cause, and the checks performed. We agree on scope before work starts.

02 / DATAFOCUSED SCOPE

Investigate a SQL discrepancy

A value in the application differs from the database or a query produces an unexpected result. I compare the data, joins and business rule.

What you receive

A documented diagnosis and, where appropriate, a corrected query or implementation recommendation.

03 / WORKFLOWFOCUSED SCOPE

Improve an Angular workflow

A form, dashboard or API interaction behaves incorrectly. I align the screen with the expected flow and backend responses.

What you receive

A focused frontend change with a clear description of what was updated and how to verify it.

04 / ABOUT

Technical depth.
Business context.

I’m Ludovic Fioklou, a software developer based in Lomé, Togo. I have worked on business applications in public-sector and financial software environments, from web development to customs workflows and integrations.

My strength is connecting what users need with what an application actually does. I can read code and data, discuss the business rule, and make the next step clear to technical and nontechnical teams.
